source.title: Frosthaven Rule Book

notes: Frosthaven is not in the active BGG Geeklist 372705 top-50 identity snapshot; this record must not be merged into that snapshot.
The public site is useful and searchable, but its own attribution identifies it as a community transcription/reference rather than a publisher-hosted rules source.
The repository API reports no license object. Public visibility does not establish permission to index or redistribute the copyrighted rule text.
